sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Target at rows 6-7, player at rows 5-6
# Press DOWN to overlap more with target

for i in range(3):
    result = action(['DOWN'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    player = None
    targets = []
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'O': player = n
        elif n['color'] == 'N' and n['pixels'] == 3: targets.append(n)
    
    red_squares = sum(1 for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'R')
    
    if player:
        p_cols = sorted([b[1] for b in player['boundary']])
        p_rows = sorted([b[0] for b in player['boundary']])
        print(f"Step {current_frame.step}: Player pixels={player['pixels']}, cols {p_cols[0]}-{p_cols[-1]}, rows {p_rows[0]}-{p_rows[-1]}")
    
    print(f"  Targets: {len(targets)}")
    for t in targets:
        t_cols = sorted([b[1] for b in t['boundary']])
        t_rows = sorted([b[0] for b in t['boundary']])
        print(f"    cols {t_cols[0]}-{t_cols[-1]}, rows {t_rows[0]}-{t_rows[-1]}")
    
    print(f"  Red squares: {red_squares}")
    
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
        print("LEVEL COMPLETED!")
        break
    if red_squares < 1:
        print("ALL TARGETS COLLECTED!")
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
